# Buttermilk pancakes

Serves 4. Ready in 25 minutes.

## Ingredients

- 200 g plain flour
- 2 tsp baking powder
- 2 eggs
- 300 ml buttermilk

## Method

1. Mix the flour and the baking powder in a large bowl.
2. Whisk the eggs into the buttermilk, then stir it into the flour.
3. Fry a ladle of batter at a time in a hot pan until golden on both sides.

Tip: Let the batter rest for five minutes so the pancakes rise evenly.
